name: paste-blocks
desc: Paste blocks to hand over in order (prompts, tool configs, bodies): a title, then one numbered row per block with its size and a Copy button; a click on a row shows the exact text. Rows stay marked Copied. Pass /title, /body (one line: where to paste) and /items [{title, text, note?}]. Long text: write a JSON file and use --data @file.json. Sticky until closed.

items.title: General instruction
items.text: You are the support assistant for Acme. Answer in two short sentences, then offer one next step.

items.title: Fallback reply
items.text: I could not find that order. Can you share the email you ordered with?
